name: zimage-v2-reconstruct
title: berkelium-zimage
description: zimage-triposr v2: the same 80 E-T3 anchor images (shipped as a hash-verified dataset), stage 3 = U²-Net segmentation (TripoSR's own preprocessing network) instead of v1 colour keying, then TripoSR on two T4s

steps.name: reconstruct
parallel: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 .venv-triposr-cuda/bin/python scripts/zimage_triposr_batch.py reconstruct --gen zimage-triposr-v2 --anchors-from zimage-triposr --segment u2net --shard 0/2
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 .venv-triposr-cuda/bin/python scripts/zimage_triposr_batch.py reconstruct --gen zimage-triposr-v2 --anchors-from zimage-triposr --segment u2net --shard 1/2
